name: Federal Realty Investment Trust
sector: Real Estate / REIT — Mixed-use shopping centers
moat_justification: Prime, supply-constrained coastal mixed-use centers (Santana Row, Assembly Row, Pike & Rose) with demonstrated pricing power — Q2 2026 comparable leases signed at +15% cash rent spreads, trailing-12-month rollover +17%, portfolio 96% leased and small-shop leased 93.9% (highest since 2007) — but the measured returns are thin: roic_proxy in fundamentals.json runs only 3.8% / 4.8% / 5.8% / 4.4% / 4.9% / 5.9% for FY2020–FY2025, the model is capital-intensive (filed capital expenditures of $246.8–311.1M a year against OCF of $555.8–622.4M), growth is partly bought ($735.3M of real-estate acquisitions in FY2025), and leverage is real (net debt $4,856,187,000 in financials_history.csv; 5.4x net debt/EBITDA per Q2 2026 reporting). A moderate 5 gives CAP 8.5 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override

SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Real Estate sector — OE/capex DCF fits real estate names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-12, accession 0000034903-26-000017), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities lines 'Capital expenditures - development and redevelopment' ($179,086 thousand FY2025, $139,534 thousand FY2024, $214,062 thousand FY2023) and 'Capital expenditures - other' ($112,252 thousand FY2025, $107,226 thousand FY2024, $97,058 thousand FY2023) — totals $291,338 thousand / $246,760 thousand / $311,120 thousand; the override value is the median of the three filed years, which is also the FY2025 total); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 15.2x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Prime coastal mixed-use REIT, moat 5/10 — Tier D on the standardized screen: TTM owner's earnings of $3.70/share after charging all $291.3M of filed capital expenditures give a 6.94% weighted IRR and IV@15% of $36.40 vs a $106.53 price; it clears 15% only below ~$36. The REIT lens is kinder (FY2026 Core FFO guided to $7.48–$7.56/share, +6.5%), but no reading of the filed numbers supports a 15% owner's-earnings return at this price.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: sector model misfit; tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Irreplaceable high-barrier coastal locations — 104 mixed-use / shopping-center properties (Santana Row, Assembly Row, Pike & Rose) in affluent, supply-constrained markets
Proven pricing power — Q2 2026 comparable leases at +15% cash rent spreads, trailing-12-month comparable rollover +17%, the highest in over 10 years
Occupancy and demand depth — portfolio 96% leased, small-shop 93.9% leased / 92.3% occupied (levels not seen since 2007), record 819,000 sq ft of comparable leasing in Q2 2026
Durability through cycles — 59 consecutive years of dividend increases (longest in the REIT sector), raised FY2026 Core FFO guidance to $7.48–$7.56/share (+6.5% at midpoint)
moat_against: Low measured returns on capital — roic_proxy only ~4–6% across FY2020–FY2025 in fundamentals.json, well below a wide-moat level
Capital intensity — filed capital expenditures run $246.8–311.1M/yr, roughly half of operating cash flow; development/redevelopment must be re-earned continuously

Growth partly bought, not only earned — $735,274,000 of real-estate acquisitions in FY2025 (10-K cash flow statement) funded with debt and share issuance (shares_diluted 81,313,000 in FY2023 to 86,405,000 in FY2025)
Leverage and rate exposure — net debt $4,856,187,000 (financials_history.csv), 5.4x net debt/EBITDA in Q2 2026 reporting; retail tenant / consumer-cycle exposure at anchor transitions

overrides.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-12, accession 0000034903-26-000017), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities lines 'Capital expenditures - development and redevelopment' ($179,086 thousand FY2025, $139,534 thousand FY2024, $214,062 thousand FY2023) and 'Capital expenditures - other' ($112,252 thousand FY2025, $107,226 thousand FY2024, $97,058 thousand FY2023) — totals $291,338 thousand / $246,760 thousand / $311,120 thousand; the override value is the median of the three filed years, which is also the FY2025 total
